description: Engine compatibility ranges (research/engine-20261021/ENGINE-BUMP.md section 1). `version` is this engine's release number; a run whose bound engine is a predecessor with version >= `resumesFrom` may resume under this engine, and the runtime records the migration (engine.migrated) in the run's chain. A predecessor is recognised only by its exact source identity: its `files` map, combined with this host's node/platform/architecture/validator, must hash to the engine hash the run recorded. Anything else is ENGINE_DRIFT, as before. This file is part of the engine identity (src/engine.mjs), so a change to a declared range is itself an engine change. It is written by the engine's maintainer after review, never by a model or a run.
changes: engine compatibility ranges and engine.migrated (this file; src/engine.mjs, src/runtime.mjs execute, src/audit.mjs engineBinding)

orch-20261021 patches 01-09: typed STORAGE_FULL/STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE; a recorded cancel request stops new starts; a handled Ctrl-C refunds a pure task's attempt (run_interrupts); outages retry on the same model then park agent nodes (status waiting, parked, parks; read only by this engine, absent from version-1 records); PDEATHSIG lifeline on spawns; budget.maxTokens and TOKEN_BUDGET (a version-1 run's bound policy has no maxTokens and keeps no runtime token limit). Each reads a version-1 record as version 1 wrote it.
verdict.remedy per stop code (rank 15): a field added to new verdicts; version-1 verdicts are read and re-graded as before (recompute compares verdict, code and authority only).

principal requirements on human nodes and workflow segregation rules (compromise D1, src/principals.mjs): optional IR fields; a version-1 run's workflow has none, its human nodes carry no bound requirement, and its answers are taken as before.
children.mjs lifelineExecFailed: setpriv's own exec failure is a launch failure (PROCESS_LAUNCH), as the spawn error was in version 1.

models/policy.mjs: DISABLE_UPDATES in the closed child-env list; an executor-only session subset may have an empty models[] (validatePolicy option executorOnly). Neither changes a version-1 run's model policy, which is bound by its own hash (MODEL_POLICY_DRIFT applies as before).

predecessors.source: commit 96cab64 (2026-10-21), the engine the 10-21 paid runs were created with
